get.summary: Reports whether the API and its database are reachable.
Current and expected balance of an account, with its starting balance and corrections.
Loan payments of a month (yyyy-MM), with totals.
Cards that allow monthly installments, with their billing details, next card payment and remaining installments.
Card payments of a month (yyyy-MM), one per card, with totals.
Each participant's shared costs, the month's (yyyy-MM) parts and contributions, and what is outstanding.
How the current month is going: key figures, what is still to pay and coming up, and section summaries.
Cards for the Settings list: Default hides archived cards and expired cards without ongoing transactions.

post.summary: Adds a card. With ?replaces={id}, the new card is linked as the replacement of that card.

get.summary: Cards shown on the Dashboard, and whether any card exists at all.
One card, with masked numbers.

put.summary: Edits a card. A null cardNumber or iban keeps the stored value; an empty string removes it.

get.summary: Reveals one full number (CardNumber or Iban) when the user asks for it.

post.summary: Marks the card as expired from today. Cannot be undone.
Archives the card instead of deleting it. Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Inputs of a month (yyyy-MM): stored inputs and calculated occurrences of recurring inputs, with totals.

post.summary: Adds an input. With a recurrence, adds a recurring input whose first occurrence has these dates.

put.summary: Edits a stored input. The recurrence field is ignored.

post.summary: Ticks Received: sets the received date to today.

delete.summary: Unticks Received: clears the received date.

put.summary: Changes the template; occurrences not yet received from today on follow it.

post.summary: Stops it: no occurrences after today.

put.summary: Changes one occurrence (by its scheduled expected date) without changing the others.

get.summary: Saved payers, optionally only those whose name contains the search text.

delete.summary: Removes the payer from the list; inputs keep its name.
Deletes an unused category; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.

put.summary: Changes date, balance and note; the kind stays.

get.summary: Received and expected inputs, and paid and expected loan and card payments, bills and expenses, per day or month between two dates.
Monthly cash flow report of a month (yyyy-MM).
Active loans (active and paid off), or closed loans.

post.summary: Adds a loan. Give the number of payments or the end month (or both, when they agree).

get.summary: Active loans with their next payment, and the totals of the monthly payments and the remaining amount.
A loan with its payment changes and all its payments.

put.summary: Edits a loan. Paid payments stay as they are.

delete.summary: Deletes a loan without paid payments; a loan with paid payments returns 409 and can only be closed.

post.summary: Closes the loan today: it keeps its paid payments and has no payments after today.
Changes the monthly payment or the payment day from a month on.

put.summary: Edits a payment change while none of the payments it covers is paid.

delete.summary: Removes a payment change while none of the payments it covers is paid.

put.summary: Changes the amount and due date of one payment without changing the loan.

post.summary: Ticks Paid. The paid date defaults to today and the account to the loan's account.

get.summary: Loan categories with their subcategories.

put.summary: Renames the category and sets whether its loans may have a residual value.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused category; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.
Deletes an unused subcategory; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.

get.summary: One card of the Cards screen: billing details, next card payment and remaining installments.
The purchases of a card, newest first.
The card payments of a card by month, newest first.
One card payment (yyyy-MM) with every purchase, installment and credit in it.

post.summary: Ticks Paid. The paid date defaults to today and the account to the card's paying account.

delete.summary: Unticks Paid, also for a card payment paid automatically.

get.summary: A purchase with its installments and the card payments they are in.

put.summary: Edits a purchase that is not reversed; its installments are recalculated.

delete.summary: Deletes a purchase with all its installments.

post.summary: Records a purchase, paid in full or in monthly installments.
Reverses the whole purchase today: charged installments are credited, the others removed.
Reverses one installment today: credited when already charged, removed otherwise.

get.summary: The shared categories of card purchases, bills and expenses.

put.summary: Renames a category; Cash withdrawal returns 409.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused category; a used one, or Cash withdrawal, returns 409.

post.summary: Hides a category from selection lists; Cash withdrawal returns 409.

get.summary: Recurring bills: active ones by name, then stopped ones when asked.

put.summary: Edits a recurring bill; bills already added from it stay unchanged.

delete.summary: Deletes a recurring bill that was never added to a month; otherwise 409.

post.summary: Stops adding the recurring bill to new months.

get.summary: The bills of a month (yyyy-MM) with totals.

post.summary: Adds a one-off bill to a month (yyyy-MM), expected or paid.
Adds a Not issued bill for every active recurring bill that has none in the month (yyyy-MM) yet.

put.summary: Edits a bill: issues it, changes it or sets its paid state.

delete.summary: Deletes a bill from its month; its recurring bill stays.

post.summary: Ticks Paid. The paid date defaults to today and what it was paid with to the bill's own.

get.summary: The expenses and cash withdrawals of a month (yyyy-MM), newest first, with totals.

post.summary: Records an expense, paid from an account or with a credit card.

get.summary: What the last expense was paid with, to prefill a new one.

post.summary: Records a cash withdrawal from a primary account.

get.summary: The people costs are shared with.

put.summary: Edits a participant; the payer of their contributions is renamed with them.

delete.summary: Deletes a participant that shares no cost.

put.summary: Shares one payment, changes its share or stops sharing it (share null), whatever the loan's share is.

delete.summary: The payment follows the loan's share again.

put.summary: Edits the contribution; it then keeps its values until it is reset to the part.

post.summary: Ticks the contribution as received: today, to its account, unless given.

delete.summary: Unticks Received; a contribution that was not edited follows its cost again.

post.summary: Reset to part: an expected contribution follows its cost again, a received one gets the current part.

put.summary: Edits the contribution; it then keeps its values until it is reset to the part.

post.summary: Ticks the contribution as received: today, to its account, unless given.

delete.summary: Unticks Received; a contribution that was not edited follows its cost again.

post.summary: Reset to part: an expected contribution follows its cost again, a received one gets the current part.
